videos.title: Tank Cannon on Wheels? The Centauro 2 Solves Recoil!

A tank cannon can shove a 67-ton tracked vehicle backwards. So how does a 120mm gun sit on rubber tires without flipping it? The barrel slides back against a hydraulic buffer, like catching a ball by pulling your hands back. Recoil on wheels is a solved problem.
